documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported strong growth momentum in Q1 FY27 with total revenue of INR3,637 million and profit after tax more than doubling to INR740 million. EBITDA grew by 120% to INR1,039 million, while steady-state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration reached 24%. Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports and B2B expansion, particularly in non-U.S. regions like the Middle East and Israel, drove performance alongside the ORIGEM retail brand footprint expansion. Goldiam International reported record consolidated performance for Q1 FY27, with total income growing by 54% year-on-year to ₹3,637 million and PAT more than doubling to ₹740 million.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for the ORIGEM business in FY27.
guidance.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

guidance.claim: The management expects double-digit growth in FY27 on an overall basis.
guidance.quote: We hope for and we are looking forward to build towards a very positive growth, double-digit growth in FY '27 on an overall basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The management expects a robust Q2 and Q3 compared to the record FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: We are looking forward to a robust Q2, Q3 compared to already record FY26, and we hope to continue the growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand scenario continues to look positive, specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.
demand_outlook.quote: So yes, the demand scenario continues to look positive, specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers are moving down in gold karatage in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs.
demand_outlook.quote: In general, we see our retailers in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs, specifically in gold, moving down in Kt.

demand_outlook.claim: Bridal jewelry accounts for about 50% of the U.S. market and fashion jewelry accounts for about 50% of the market.
demand_outlook.quote: It's -- so in general, for the U.S. jewelry industry, bridal jewelry is about 50% of the market and fashion jewelry is about 50% of the market.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam has 26 operational stores under the brand name ORIGEM across key cities.
capex_expansion.quote: As on date, Goldiam has 26 operational stores under the brand name ORIGEM across key cities.

capex_expansion.claim: ORIGEM has doubled its store count from January 2026, now having 24 operational stores across 12 cities.
capex_expansion.quote: From January 2026 till now, ORIGEM, Goldiam's India retail lab-grown diamond jewelry brand has doubled its store count, now having 24 operational stores across 12 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: There are 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up that will all be operational by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Goldiam's EBITDA for Q1 FY2027 grew by 120% to INR1,039 million.
margins_costs.quote: Goldiam's EBITDA for Q1 FY 2027 grew by 120% to INR1,039 million.

margins_costs.claim: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.
margins_costs.quote: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY2027 grew by 120.5% to ₹1,039 million.
margins_costs.quote: ◊ EBITDA & PAT: EBITDA for Q1 FY2027 grew by a 120.5% to ₹ 1039 million.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 2026 stood at 23.9% and for the full year FY 2026 stood at 24.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q4 2026 at INR583 million grew by 35.9% with EBITDA margin of 23.9%. EBITDA for FY 2026 at INR2,486.7 million grew by 36.2% with EBITDA margin of 24.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Margins are increasing on a steady-state basis due to the hybrid casting model leveraging production in the U.S.
margins_costs.quote: We see margins increasing on a steady-state basis, specifically due to the hybrid casting model where we are able to leverage production in the U.S. and working with fantastic factories in America to support our jewelry value addition and production in India

margins_costs.claim: The dual casting method is expected to provide an incremental gross margin impact of between 200 to 300 basis points on a full year basis.
margins_costs.quote: It's about between 200 to 300 basis point increment that we are expecting on a full year basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as of June 30, 2026, was approximately ₹2,250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: ◊ Order Book Status: Goldiam’s order book position as on June 30, 2026 was at about ₹ 2250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Eco-Friendly Diamonds LLP operates about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ non-stop.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ that are operating nonstop.

capital_allocation.claim: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3.
capital_allocation.quote: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3 by utilizing an amount of INR7,52,78,562.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents including investments were ₹4,566.71 million as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: ◊ Cash and Cash Equivalents (including investments) were at ₹ 4566.71 million as at June, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments, were at INR4,933.92 million as on March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments were at INR4,933.92 million as on March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share in the ratio of 1:3 fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share in the ratio 1:3 fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each in proportion of new fully paid up equity share of INR2 for every 3 existing fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each, subject to the approval of shareholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Here, I would like you to note that Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the recent increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations, financial performance or profitability.

management_commitments.claim: The management targets to open about 7 new ORIGEM stores before pre-Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: These 7 stores will come in come in between now and our target is to get them open before -- by pre-Diwali.

management_commitments.claim: The order book as of June 30, 2026, is expected to be executed in the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores to be operational by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach in the range of 45 to 50 COCO stores by exit of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: But by exit FY '27, the ideal goal is to be in the range of 45 to 50 COCO stores.

management_commitments.claim: ORIGEM plans to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense for the first half of fiscal 2027.
management_commitments.quote: For the first half of fiscal 2027, we are looking forward to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
